agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario shows sensor_noise ~0.015 with dt~0.015 causes controller to be fed noisy angle/omega. Inspection shows theta grows from -0.2 at step 30 to 0.22 at 38, 0.44 at 40 with omega ~8 rad/s and controller force >40 N, pumping energy to 37 J (external work 36 J) despite no pushes. At step 43 theta=0.86 exceeds 0.8 limit. Removing noise (counterfactual) stabilizes: identical plant and gains succeed, proving noise+dt interaction drives feedback instability.
